Gurugram.name: Sohna Road
Gurugram.description: Chronic bottleneck between Subhash Chowk and Badshahpur; severe water buildup on both carriageways.

Gurugram.name: Golf Course Extension Road
Gurugram.description: Repeated flooding at key junctions and service lanes, heavy traffic paralysis during monsoon.

Gurugram.name: Narsinghpur (NH-48)
Gurugram.description: Notorious 3-4 feet water accumulation on NH-48 main carriage and service lanes; halts Delhi-Jaipur traffic.

Gurugram.name: Rajiv Chowk
Gurugram.description: Major intersection connecting Old Gurugram, NH-48 and Sohna road. Underpass and slip roads submerge.

Gurugram.name: Hero Honda Chowk
Gurugram.description: Badshahpur drain overflow spot. Historic site of Gurujam; underpasses prone to prompt closure.

Gurugram.name: Udyog Vihar
Gurugram.description: Critical IT / Industrial cluster near Delhi border; internal roads face severe knee-deep flooding.

Gurugram.name: Subhash Chowk
Gurugram.description: Sohna Road connector. Underpass flooded for hours during moderate to heavy rain.

Gurugram.name: Basai Chowk
Gurugram.description: Low-lying junction connecting Old Gurugram and Dwarka Expressway sectors; poor natural drainage.

Gurugram.name: IFFCO Chowk
Gurugram.description: Key transit hub for buses & metro commuters. Slip lanes and pedestrian underpasses waterlog.

Gurugram.name: Golf Course Road
Gurugram.description: Rapid Metro corridor and underpasses (Genpact, DLF Phase 1) vulnerable during intense cloudbursts.

Gurugram.name: Khandsa Road
Gurugram.description: Near NH-48 culverts; dense traffic with heavy backflow from clogged storm channels.

Gurugram.name: Sector 14 Gurugram
Gurugram.description: Commercial heart of Old Gurugram; market parking and main road experience steady pooling.

Gurugram.name: Vatika Chowk
Gurugram.description: Intersection of Sohna Road and Southern Peripheral Road (SPR); heavy run-off from Aravalli foothills.

Gurugram.name: Sheetla Mata Road
Gurugram.description: High footfall religious and commuter corridor; water enters adjoining residential colonies.

Gurugram.name: Palam Vihar
Gurugram.description: Low-lying blocks C & D suffer prolonged water retention after heavy spells.

Gurugram.name: Cyber City / Shankar Chowk
Gurugram.description: Entry point to DLF Cyber City; slow discharge leads to rapid traffic tailbacks onto NH-48.

Gurugram.name: Dwarka Expressway (Sector 100-104)
Gurugram.description: New developing sectors; incomplete roadside drainage creates large temporary lakes on service lanes.

Chandigarh.name: Madhya Marg (Sec 26 & Tribune Chowk Stretch)
Chandigarh.description: Primary east-west arterial; drain capacity designed for only 15 mm/hr, collapses during intense bursts.

Chandigarh.name: Tribune Chowk
Chandigarh.description: Official MC 2025 hotspot list; primary Tricity gateway with knee-deep water disrupting Panchkula-Zirakpur movement.

Chandigarh.name: Hallomajra
Chandigarh.description: Low-lying area near airport road; water enters ground-floor houses and interior links.

Chandigarh.name: Industrial Area Phase I & II
Chandigarh.description: Underpasses and internal commercial roads flood quickly; CTU workshop and railway approaches affected.

Chandigarh.name: Industrial Area Underpass (Railway Station)
Chandigarh.description: Submerged underpass; fire brigade rescues required for stranded cars during peak rains.

Chandigarh.name: Manimajra (Shastri Nagar)
Chandigarh.description: Adjacent to seasonal rivulet; runoff overwhelms storm sewers causing prolonged stagnation.

Chandigarh.name: Sukhna Choe Low-Level Bridges & Kishangarh
Chandigarh.description: Low bridges submerged whenever Sukhna lake floodgates open; police enforce mandatory diversions.

Chandigarh.name: Southern Sectors (33, 34, 35, 45)
Chandigarh.description: Sectors 33, 34, 35 and 45 show repeat road cave-ins and flooded roundabouts (GMCH-32 & JW Marriott).

Chandigarh.name: ISBT-17 & Sector 22 Mobile Market
Chandigarh.description: Basements and showroom entries submerge in Sector 22 market; bus terminals slow down.

Chandigarh.name: Toga Bridge (New Chandigarh Link)
Chandigarh.description: Seasonal torrent bridge on periphery; recorded vehicle washaway during June deluge.
